name: JellyRequest
description: Users request media, admins manage the full request lifecycle.
overview: A Jellyfin plugin for media requests: pending, done, rejected, snoozed, archived. Customizable request form and admin dashboard.

versions.changelog: Request button works in the Jellyfin 12 header (and survives header re-renders). Uses the standard Authorization header. Request dates shown as YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM.

Snoozed requests auto-unsnooze when the snooze date passes; archiving clears the snooze. Mobile: modal fields stay reachable above the on-screen keyboard. Fix edit form rejecting requests with empty optional fields.
